item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 21/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring hot and generally fine weather to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. A southwesterly airstream will continue to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong for the rest of this week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week. Showers will increase gradually over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of southern China.
